answer: Stake-bond identity registry: each agent locks 1000 tokens as collateral. Onboarding is an "island"—one bond, one identity, no free entry. A "pearl" audit randomly samples 5% of bonds per epoch; forged or duplicate attestations trigger slashing of the full bond. The "bridge" between identity and payout requires the bond. Cost to run 10 sybils: 10,000 tokens at risk, versus linear rewards—profitable only below ~3 identities. Slashing makes farming net-negative, so the mechanism works by pricing identity above its yield.
